38:   3. **GrantCache 死结构收敛（必做）**：`CachedGrant.grant` 当前写入即弃（`warning: field 'grant' is never read` @`:68:5`，F02 集成显式接受），处置=删除 `CachedGrant`/`GrantCache` 及其无观察效果的 map 操作，或给出真实消费方（须与 F-01 每请求 resolve 语义兼容）；

41:   6. （可选补强）机理对照实验：区分"同 tick 碰撞" vs "LazyWriter 元数据延迟"（F02 诊断 P3-7 遗留，跨 tick 负向对照）。

1: //! The `m2res` custom URI scheme protocol (M2-RC1).
2: //!
3: //! URL form (Windows/WebView2): `http://m2res.localhost/m2id/<opaque-id>?chunk=<n>`
4: //!
5: //! Serving pipeline per request (RC1-AC4, M2-S2 semantics productised):
6: //! 1. opaque-ID format gate (43-char base64url) — malformed before any lookup;
7: //! 2. EVERY request resolves via the Core control bridge first (F-01): a
8: //!    Core rejection propagates typed errors (REF_UNKNOWN_ID / REF_REVOKED /
9: //!    REF_EXPIRED). There is deliberately NO host-side grant cache: the
10: //!    resolve result is consumed directly (the write-only GrantCache remnant
11: //!    was removed by M2-FIX-RESOURCE-CHANNEL-DIGEST-PERF);
12: //! 3. open the target **once** (GENERIC_READ / FILE_SHARE_READ /
13: //!    FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS) and verify **from that handle**: containment
14: //!    (final path re-derived from the handle stays inside the scope root),
15: //!    file identity (volume serial + file index vs issue-time facts), size
16: //!    (issue-time size + T1 256 MiB limit);
17: //! 4. the issue-time digest is re-verified through the handle on EVERY
18: //!    request (F-02: catches equal-size in-place rewrites; an mtime-gated
19: //!    short-circuit is unsound because NTFS LastWriteTime granularity
20: //!    follows the system timer tick, so a rewrite landing in the same tick
21: //!    as the verified write reads back the identical mtime) without
22: //!    materialising the file;
23: //! 5. the requested chunk (≤16 MiB) is CAPTURED during that same single
24: //!    sequential read, so the served bytes are exactly the digest-covered
25: //!    bytes — no digest→serve TOCTOU window remains;
26: //! 6. re-check identity after reading.
27: //!
28: //! Responses are always `Cache-Control: no-store` (revocation must never be
29: //! served from a cache; the M2-S3 probe measured the bypass contrast) and
30: //! carry permissive CORS so the `tauri.localhost` page may fetch them.
31: //! Errors are stable typed codes in a JSON body; no OS path, mapping-table
32: //! entry, revision fingerprint or digest ever appears in a response.
33: 
34: use crate::core_bridge::{CoreChannel, CoreError, Grant};
35: use serde_json::json;
36: use sha2::{Digest as ShaDigest, Sha256};
37: use std::path::PathBuf;
38: 
39: pub const SCHEME_HOST: &str = "m2res.localhost";
40: pub const CHUNK_SIZE: u64 = 16 * 1024 * 1024; // T4: resident buffer ≤ 32 MiB
41: pub const MAX_RESOURCE_BYTES: u64 = 256 * 1024 * 1024; // T1 commitment line
42: pub const ID_LENGTH: usize = 43; // base64url of 32 random bytes
43: 
44: const GENERIC_READ: u32 = 0x8000_0000;
45: const FILE_SHARE_READ: u32 = 0x0000_0001;
46: const OPEN_EXISTING: u32 = 3;
47: const FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS: u32 = 0x0200_0000;
48: const FILE_BEGIN: u32 = 0;
49: 
50: pub struct ScopeRoots {
51:     pub derived: PathBuf,
52:     pub managed: PathBuf,
53: }
54: 
55: impl ScopeRoots {
56:     fn root_for(&self, scope_class: &str) -> Option<&PathBuf> {
57:         match scope_class {
58:             "derived-read-only" => Some(&self.derived),
59:             "managed-read-only" => Some(&self.managed),
60:             _ => None, // user-source has no servable root (T5.3)
61:         }
62:     }
63: }
64: 
65: // (M2-FIX-RESOURCE-CHANNEL-DIGEST-PERF) The former `GrantCache`/`CachedGrant`
66: // is gone. After the F-02 fix removed the last read consumer, the cache was
67: // write-only: `CachedGrant.grant` was inserted and never read (dead code,
68: // F02 integration C2-(b)), and every request already resolved via the Core
69: // unconditionally (F-01) and consumed `fresh_grant` directly. There is no
70: // cached state left to invalidate: revocation/expiry live entirely in the
71: // Core resolve, and `Cache-Control: no-store` still forbids WebView caching.
72: 
73: pub struct HttpResponse {
74:     pub status: u16,
75:     pub content_type: &'static str,
76:     pub body: Vec<u8>,
77:     pub cache_control: &'static str,
78: }
79: 
80: impl HttpResponse {
81:     fn error(code: &str, status: u16) -> Self {
82:         Self {
83:             status,
84:             content_type: "application/json",
85:             body: json!({ "code": code }).to_string().into_bytes(),
86:             cache_control: "no-store",
87:         }
88:     }
89: 
90:     fn ok(content_type: &'static str, body: Vec<u8>) -> Self {
91:         Self {
92:             status: 200,
93:             content_type,
94:             body,
95:             cache_control: "no-store",
96:         }
97:     }
98: }
99: 
100: fn status_for(code: &str) -> u16 {
101:     match code {
102:         "REF_MALFORMED" => 400,
103:         "REF_UNKNOWN_ID" | "REF_NOT_FOUND" => 404,
104:         "REF_OUT_OF_SCOPE" | "REF_REPARSE_POINT" | "REF_SCOPE_DENIED" | "RESOURCE_TOO_LARGE"
105:         | "RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED" => 403,
106:         "REF_REVOKED" | "REF_EXPIRED" => 410,
107:         _ => 400,
108:     }
109: }
110: 
111: fn typed_error(error: &CoreError) -> HttpResponse {
112:     let code = error.code.split(':').next().unwrap_or("REF_MALFORMED").to_string();

125: fn parse_request(uri: &str) -> Option<(String, ParsedRequest)> {
126:     // returns (host, parsed); the caller validates the host (F-10)
127:     let rest = uri.split_once("://")?.1;
128:     let (host, host_path) = match rest.split_once('/') {
129:         Some((h, hp)) => (h.to_string(), hp),
130:         None => (rest.to_string(), ""),
131:     };
132:     let (path, query) = match host_path.split_once('?') {
133:         Some((p, q)) => (p, Some(q)),
134:         None => (host_path, None),
135:     };
136:     let segment = path.split('/').last().unwrap_or("");
137:     let chunk = query
138:         .and_then(|q| {
139:             q.split('&').find_map(|pair| {
140:                 let (k, v) = pair.split_once('=')?;
141:                 if k == "chunk" {
142:                     v.parse::<u64>().ok()
143:                 } else {
144:                     None
145:                 }
146:             })
147:         })
148:         .unwrap_or(0);
149:     Some((
150:         host.to_lowercase(),
151:         ParsedRequest {
152:             opaque_id: percent_decode(segment),
153:             chunk,
154:         },
155:     ))
156: }

158: fn percent_decode(text: &str) -> String {
159:     let bytes = text.as_bytes();
160:     let mut out: Vec<u8> = Vec::with_capacity(bytes.len());
161:     let mut index = 0;
162:     while index < bytes.len() {
163:         if bytes[index] == b'%' && index + 2 < bytes.len() {
164:             if let Ok(byte) = u8::from_str_radix(&text[index + 1..index + 3], 16) {
165:                 out.push(byte);
166:                 index += 3;
167:                 continue;
168:             }
169:         }
170:         out.push(bytes[index]);
171:         index += 1;
172:     }
173:     String::from_utf8_lossy(&out).into_owned()
174: }

181: }
